**About The Role**
 As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play a key role in Anthropic's mission of building safe and beneficial AI by driving data\-informed decision\-making across the organization. You'll be embedded with teams supporting our Developer Platform — the infrastructure that enables developers and enterprise customers to build on Claude via our core API, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, and knowledge management capabilities.
   

  

 In this role, you'll partner closely with product, engineering, and go\-to\-market teams to understand how AI agents are being built and deployed at scale. You'll identify growth opportunities, surface insights about platform adoption, and drive data\-informed decisions that shape our platform roadmap. You'll also help establish the analytical foundations and best practices of a data science team that is still defining itself — bringing rigor and clarity to a fast\-moving environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Define key metrics, build measurement frameworks, and maintain core reporting to evaluate platform success
* Conduct deep dives into product and usage data to surface actionable insights, size opportunities, and influence roadmaps across product, engineering, and go\-to\-market teams
* Develop hypotheses and apply rigorous causal inference methods — including controlled experiments and synthetic controls — to evaluate platform changes and make actionable recommendations
* Investigate anomalies, conduct root cause analyses, and provide data\-driven insights to guide priorities and inform decisions
* Build statistical models, optimization frameworks, and simulations to support and automate operational and decision\-making processes
* Present complex analyses and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Help establish foundational data practices and scale analytics infrastructure to support rapid iteration as the platform grows

* Expertise in experimental design, causal inference, statistical modeling, and A/B testing, particularly in high\-scale technical environments
* Experience working closely with Product or Engineering teams on API or developer\-facing products, with demonstrated impact on product roadmap and strategy
* Effective written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of experience in data science or analytics roles
* Experience supporting B2B sales teams with data insights
* Strong instincts for what drives product adoption, engagement, and retention in developer or enterprise contexts
* Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where creating clarity is part of the role
* A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission of building safe and beneficial AI

**About The Role**
 Harman International is seeking a highly skilled Principal Backend Engineer to join its Music Discovery Platform team. In this pivotal role, you will lead the development of scalable, high\-performance backend systems that power our innovative music discovery and metadata services. Your expertise will be instrumental in architecting and building APIs that facilitate seamless music search, personalized recommendations, and user interactions, ensuring a smooth and engaging user experience. As a key member of the Data Team, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, frontend developers, and data scientists to develop data\-driven features that enhance the platform’s capabilities. Your work will involve designing robust data models, managing integrations with third\-party music metadata providers, and optimizing backend services for low latency and high availability. This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the future of music discovery technology by driving technical innovation, mentoring junior engineers, and establishing best practices for backend development in a dynamic, global environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of experience in backend services development
* Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Node.js, Python, or Go
* Deep understanding of API design, microservices architecture, and cloud\-native development
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure
* Expertise with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes
* Knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, or similar, along with caching strategies and message queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Familiarity with music metadata standards, recommendation systems, or audio streaming APIs is a plus
* Experience with machine learning pipelines or recommendation engines is desirable
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment


**Responsibilities**
* Architect and develop robust, scalable, and secure APIs for music catalog, search, and recommendation services
* Design and optimize data models, managing integrations with third\-party metadata providers, streaming platforms, and analytics tools
* Lead backend engineering efforts by establishing coding standards, conducting code reviews, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaborate with product teams, frontend developers, and data scientists to define API contracts and ensure seamless user experiences
* Implement performance optimization techniques to ensure low latency and high system availability
* Set up and maintain observability tools for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system reliability and uptime
* Evaluate and incorporate new technologies, frameworks, and best practices to improve development velocity and system capabilities
* Drive innovation in backend architecture to support evolving product requirements and scalability needs
